units.source_text: 信子从在女子大学读书的时候，就有了才媛的称号，大家都认为早晚有一天，她会在文坛崭露头角，成为一个优秀的作家。

en.t: Ever since Nobuko was studying at a women's university, she had been known as a talented young woman, and everyone thought that sooner or later she would make her mark in the literary world and become an excellent writer.

units.source_text: 有人还宣扬说，她在读书的时候就写了自传体小说，多达三百多页。

en.t: Some people even spread the story that while she was still in school she had written an autobiographical novel of more than three hundred pages.
